title: 搜索二维矩阵
statement: 给定一个 m × n 的整数矩阵 matrix：每一行按非严格递增排列，且每一行的第一个数都大于上一行的最后一个数。给定整数 target，判断它是否在矩阵中，在则返回 true，否则返回 false。

en.title: Search a 2D Matrix
en.statement: Given an m × n integer matrix in which each row is sorted in non-decreasing order and the first number of each row is greater than the last number of the previous row, and an integer target, determine whether target is in the matrix: return true if it is, otherwise false.

complexity.officialRequirement: Official problem requires O(log(m·n)) time complexity.
complexity.notes: m and n are the row and column counts; the input matrix does not count toward extra space. Flattened row by row, the matrix is a sorted array where index k maps to matrix[k / n][k % n], so binary search directly; alternatively, binary search the row and then the column. The local judge needs O(m·n) to read input, so it cannot distinguish binary search from a linear scan by running time.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: first line the row count m; then m lines, each starting with the column count n followed by that row's n integers; the last line is target. stdout: true or false.

complexity.officialRequirement: 官方要求 O(log(m·n)) 时间复杂度。
complexity.notes: m、n 为行列数，输入矩阵不计入额外空间。整个矩阵按行展开后是一个有序数组，下标 k 对应 matrix[k / n][k % n]，直接二分；也可先二分行再二分列。本地判题需 O(m·n) 读入，无法从耗时上区分二分与线性扫描。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行行数 m；随后 m 行，每行先写列数 n，再写该行 n 个整数；最后一行为 target。stdout：true 或 false。
